messages.subject: Is fsQCA a ML techique
parts:

Thanks in advance,

Pedro Carmona

messages.author: 53dbab5845ace6b6
messages.subject: Re: Is fsQCA a ML techique
parts:
Dear Pedro,

My personal belief is both QCA and ML search for patterns associated with a certain outcome. In that respect, they are similar but the method is very different.
ML operates on large data using statistical techniques, while QCA operates on case studies (small to medium N) using Boolean Algebra.

There is a recent article comparing both, by Chiu and Xu from Stanford, in case one is interested:
https://www.journals.uchicago.edu/doi/full/10.1086/720791

I hope this helps,
Adrian
